hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: The synergistic combination of collagen, EGF peptides, and Centella Asiatica extract is supported by research demonstrating their roles in skin elasticity, wrinkle reduction, and barrier repair. Studies highlight Centella Asiatica's regenerative properties and collagen's structural support, while peptides are known for their anti-aging signaling functions. (PMID: 42252897, 42280293, 42343000)
